biography.plain_text: Peter Lürssen is a German shipbuilder and co-owner of the Bremen-based Lürssen business. A fourth-generation family principal, he joined the company in 1987 and has led it alongside his cousin Friedrich. The business expanded across northern Germany, combining custom yacht construction with naval shipbuilding before selling its military division to Rheinmetall.

long_biography.plain_text:
Shipbuilder Peter Lürssen studied shipbuilding and industrial engineering in Germany and business administration in the United States. Before entering the family firm, he spent a year inspecting construction at Japanese shipyards and familiarised himself with several departments at Lürssen.

He joined the board of Water Revolution Foundation in 2019, bringing practical industry experience to a nonprofit concerned with environmental sustainability. Its programme brings businesses and scientific expertise together to measure the effects of design and construction choices, assess technical solutions and support ocean conservation. The foundation also develops training to help the industry put those changes into practice.
long_biography.html:
Shipbuilder Peter Lürssen studied shipbuilding and industrial engineering in Germany and business administration in the United States. Before entering the family firm, he spent a year inspecting construction at Japanese shipyards and familiarised himself with several departments at Lürssen.

He joined the board of Water Revolution Foundation in 2019, bringing practical industry experience to a nonprofit concerned with environmental sustainability. Its programme brings businesses and scientific expertise together to measure the effects of design and construction choices, assess technical solutions and support ocean conservation. The foundation also develops training to help the industry put those changes into practice.
